inline.$description: Rule: elements side by side in one group – buttons, tags, filters. 8 px.

content.$description: Rule: inside one block – heading, text, actions. 16 px.

fields.$description: Rule: form fields below each other. 16 · 24 · 24 px.

items.$description: Rule: cards and tiles in a grid or list. Equals layout/gutter (16 · 24 · 24 px).

group.$description: Rule: groups inside a section – sub-sections, fieldsets. 32 · 40 · 48 px.

section.$description: Rule: sections of a page. Equals layout/section (48 · 64 · 96 px).
